title: 'The Regent's Commission' was still listed as an unfinished quest at the true ending even though the envoy had already told me its stated condition (serve the Watch twice) was met and all that remained was to 'claim' an already-earned, no-longer-needed writ — nothing marked the remaining step as optional/reward-only rather than a real requirement.
